title: GraphPayload
description: Payload format for entities and relationships extracted from voice conversations to update the knowledge graph.

source.description: Source identifier, e.g. voice_conversation_20261010_1300 or transcript file.

entities.description: List of extracted entities to upsert into the graph.

relationships.description: List of relationships connecting the extracted entities.

type.description: Entity label. Recommended standard labels: Person, Task, Project, Meeting, Deadline, Organization, Location, Event, Concept, Note. Unknown types are normalized to Concept.

name.description: Display name of the referenced entity (non-empty).

type.description: Entity label. Recommended standard labels: Person, Task, Project, Meeting, Deadline, Organization, Location, Event, Concept, Note. Unknown types are normalized to Concept with props['original_type'].

props.description: Optional whitelisted entity attributes with scalar values (str, int, float, bool).

status.description: Status of a task or project.

priority.description: Priority level, e.g. low, medium, high.

date.description: Date or deadline string in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

label.description: Original relationship type when converted to RELATED_TO.

original_type.description: Original entity type before fallback normalization to Concept.

kind.description: Sub-category or classifier for concepts or notes.

from.description: Source entity of the directed edge.

type.description: Relationship type. Recommended: ASSIGNED_TO, PART_OF, WORKS_ON, ATTENDED, DISCUSSED, DUE_ON, LOCATED_AT, MEMBER_OF, MENTIONS, RELATED_TO. Unknown types or invalid directions fallback to RELATED_TO.

to.description: Target entity of the directed edge.

props.description: Optional whitelisted relationship attributes with scalar values (str, int, float, bool).

label.description: Original relationship type stored when normalized to RELATED_TO.
